picks.title: Vicon Acquires Captive Devices Facial Capture Firm
picks.excerpt: The Oxford Metrics motion capture division picks up the Manchester maker of the CoreHMC head-mounted rig, which feeds performer data into Unreal Engine and MetaHuman Animator.
picks.rationale: Concrete performance-capture pipeline consolidation — CoreHMC feeding Unreal/MetaHuman changes what a facial-capture stage can budget for next season.

picks.title: Mind The Gap selling AI Val Kilmer in 'As Deep As The Grave' at TIFF
picks.excerpt: Mind The Gap arrived at TIFF: The Market selling historical drama 'As Deep As The Grave,' which uses AI to recreate the late Val Kilmer in a role he signed on for before his death — with family permission, SAG-AFTRA compliance and estate compensation.
picks.rationale: A synthetic-performance deal actually going to market with consent, SAG-AFTRA compliance and estate payment — the template other productions will be asked to copy.

picks.title: Kling AI's TIFF Market Panel Illuminates Tech Challenges and Human-Led Solutions in AI Filmmaking
picks.excerpt: Kling AI powered and hosts the TIFF The Market panel 'New Creative Paradigm: Consistent, Cinematic AI Video' in Toronto.
picks.rationale: Working filmmakers naming where generative video still breaks — consistency, continuity, control — and how they route around it on real shoots.

picks.title: Animation Vets Joel Kuwahara & Mark Evestaff Launch 'The Salty Tales of Tony & Keith' AI-Assisted Series
picks.excerpt: 'The Salty Tales of Tony & Keith' is a hybrid traditional/AI assisted pipeline 2D series from alums of 'Bob's Burgers' and 'The Snoopy Show.'
picks.rationale: Veteran 2D showrunners publishing an actual hybrid hand-drawn/AI pipeline — a concrete production model rather than a manifesto.

picks.title: Venice Jury President Maggie Gyllenhaal on Her Short 'Flesh Impact,' Casting Ellen Burstyn, and AI
picks.excerpt: Venice 2026 competition jury president Maggie Gyllenhaal discusses her short 'Flesh Impact,' starring Ellen Burstyn, and why her AI experiment failed.
picks.rationale: A director who ran the AI experiment on a real short and reports exactly where it broke — the rare negative result with craft detail attached.
